sections.title: Form and habitat
sections.text: A woolly perennial of dry, sandy soils in Europe. It is usually 8–30 cm tall and sometimes reaches about 50 cm.

sections.title: Flowers and fruit
sections.text: Golden-yellow to orange flower heads grow in tight clusters. After flowering, each achene bears a pappus that aids dispersal.

sections.title: Traditional use
sections.text: The European Medicines Agency recognizes traditional use of the flowers in preparations for relief of some mild digestive complaints. This is not general proof of clinical efficacy or a recommendation for self-medication.
